pooled.sentence_the_evidence_supports: 47 of the top 60 'false positives' are days belonging to known insiders that fall inside or within 28 days of their labelled attack window. Our highest-scoring false positives are, on inspection, genuine anomalous behaviour that the ground-truth windows fail to label; the reported precision is therefore a lower bound.

7 of the top 10 false positives belong to users with no labelled attack at all (largest |z| seen: 10.0). These are genuine false positives — an honest failure mode, and the precision figures should be read at face value rather than as a lower bound.
